title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — Connection Center onboarding contract
purpose: Implement the self-service Connection Center decision contract from section 22 before the settings UI: where accounting is kept, where 1C runs, honest UNKNOWN paths, recipient handoff and the exact connection-status vocabulary. The contract must not expose technical secret/configuration fields by default.
boundaries: Accounting-system choice is 1C, OTHER or UNKNOWN; 1C location is FRESH, LOCAL_OR_SERVER, SERVICE_COMPANY or UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN never blocks into a technical dead end: it exposes send-to-accountant and/or send-to-1C-admin handoff actions.
Connection status is exactly NOT_CONNECTED, CONNECTING, HEALTHY, DEGRADED, ACTION_REQUIRED, OFFLINE, REVOKED, SECURITY_HOLD.
Default user-facing connection summary never includes OData, OAuth scopes, client_secret, endpoint or refresh token.
No connector pairing, vendor credential, API mutation, UI route, Prisma, auth, banking, FGIS, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
